Freud, like [Jung](jung.qmd), is about constructing narratives and telling
stories. The [Stories](../concepts/stories.qmd) note collects the other sources
on that idea.

## Religion

Freud and Jung divide on religion, and the divide comes down to the question
each one asks of it.

- Freud asks what psychological needs produce religious belief.
- Jung asks what psychological truths religious belief might express.

*The Brothers Karamazov* has a parallel. Ivan challenges belief
intellectually, above all through the suffering of innocent children. Alyosha
comes to faith through love, through his relationships and through how he
lives. Calling Ivan a Freudian and Alyosha a Jungian would be too simple, but
the pair shows the divide.
